items.headline: Sources: Ravens trade 4th-, 7th-rounders to get Jacoby Brissett, 5th-round pick
items.description: The Ravens will acquire quarterback Jacoby Brissett and a 2027 fifth-round pick for a fourth-round pick in 2027 and seventh-round pick in 2028, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.
